about: Third-party algorithm and project names that a shader may carry only with provenance (#1791). awakeVerify fails a main shader source under awake/ that matches a pattern unless docs/reference/source-provenance.json has an entry for its path whose reason matches the same pattern, or a line below holds it pending a review. Pending lines only shrink.

pending.tracker: #1791, the line "Provenance check for the other post-processing shaders": Kawase's and Bjørge's are published algorithms, and no source code is known to have been adapted, so the review is of where this implementation came from.
